subject: POC session format & site access coordination for Nov hands-on
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit@fincloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-25T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC session — proposed dates, onsite vs virtual, and access asks

Hi Amit —

Thanks again for agreeing to a hands-on POC for FinCloud. We want to lock down the format (onsite, virtual, or hybrid), finalize the agenda, and reserve a short window for a load test and routing validation. Proposed options:

- Option A: Onsite at FinCloud HQ — Wed Nov 3, 9:00–13:00 PT (preferred for prompts + routing review)
- Option B: Hybrid — Nov 3 morning onsite for attendees + live stream for remote engineers
- Option C: Fully virtual — Nov 4 (morning) if onsite isn’t possible

Key asks from your side if we go onsite:
- Visitor badge process for 2 Redwood engineers (names below)
- A conference room with projector + HDMI and a small load test-friendly network (we’ll coordinate IPs)
- Permission to record the screen for internal replay/notes

Attached is a draft agenda (POC-agenda-v2.pdf) — short prompt-review, routing checks, and a ~45min load/run validation.

Next steps: which option works for you? If onsite, please confirm badge process and an on-site contact for networking.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0143

Attachments: POC-agenda-v2.pdf (PDF)

Date: 2026-10-26T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC session — proposed dates, onsite vs virtual, and access asks

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for the options. Hybrid on Nov 3 works best for our team — two of us (me + Priya) will be onsite, and engineering (infra + payments) will join remotely. A couple quick Qs: 

- Visitor badges: we need full name, company, and DOB for the building. Is that acceptable?
- Recording: internal OK, but we need to confirm that Redwood will not share recordings externally.
- Network: infra@fincloud.com (cc'd) will coordinate. Can you share the network checklist?

If you can confirm the list of Redwood attendees, we’ll start security screening.

-Amit
Amit Shah
Head of Product, FinCloud Payments
amit@fincloud.com | +1 212-555-2211
